# Better Level Browser

A tiny mod that completely overhauls the level browser

## Features

* Level Browser Toggle - lets you switch between old and new level browser
* New level browser - new level browser :)

## Notes

Better level browser is a completely separate layer from normal level browser -> "LevelBrowserLayerExtra"
